notes.title: Challengers Open!
notes.content:
Challenge for 5 times everyday for 4 weeks, and get the Rare items & many rewards until August 31 (Pacific Time)!

[b]Summary of the rewards[/b]
- Daily Reward: Discount Coupon, Love/Double Power, Mutual Emotes, Seed, Pot, Couple Pose, VIP Room
- Special Reward: Rare items
- Ranking Reward: Free Coupon*, EMOPET Egg, Permanent Hair/Pants/Shoes Coupon
*The free coupon can be exchanged for a permanent item.

[b]How do I join?[/b]
1. Go to "Challengers" page.
2. Click "Join" button on the bottom of the page.
3. When matching is done, you will enter to a room for the game automatically.
4. After countdown, the game starts.
5. You can get the daily reward when you get 5 stars (match count).
6. You can get the special reward when you get 140 stars (match count) in total. You should receive the daily and special rewards before the event is over.
7. After the event is over, top 100 players are able to receive their ranking reward until September 06 (Pacific Time) in the page.

notes.title: Challengers Open!
notes.content:
Challenge for 5 times everyday for 4 weeks, and get the Rare items & many rewards until May 31(Pacific Time)!

[b]Summary of the rewards[/b]
- Daily Reward: Discount Coupon, Love/Double Power, Mutual Emotes, Seed, Pot, Couple Pose, VIP Room
- Special Reward: Rare items
- Ranking Reward: Free Coupon*, EMOPET Egg, Permanent Hair/Pants/Shoes Coupon
*The free coupon can be exchanged for a permanent item.

[b]How do I join?[/b]
1. Go to "Challengers" page.
2. Click "Join" button on the bottom of the page.
3. When matching is done, you will enter to a room for the game automatically.
4. After countdown, the game starts.
5. You can get the daily reward when you get 5 stars (match count).
6. You can get the special reward when you get 140 stars (match count) in total. You should receive the daily and special rewards before the event is over.
7. After the event is over, top 100 players are able to receive their ranking reward until June 21 (Pacific Time) in the page.

notes.title: Challengers Open!
notes.content:
Challenge for 5 times everyday for 4 weeks, and get the Rare items & many rewards until December 7 (Pacific Time)!

[b]Summary of the rewards[/b]
- Daily Reward: Discount Coupon, Love/Double Power, Mutual Emotes, Seed, Pot, Couple Pose, VIP Room
- Special Reward: Rare items
- Ranking Reward: Free Coupon*, Fairytale Whale Egg, Permanent Hair/Pants/Shoes Coupon
*The free coupon can be exchanged for a permanent item.

[b]How do I join?[/b]
1. Go to "Challengers" page.
2. Click "Join" button on the bottom of the page.
3. When matching is done, you will enter to a room for the game automatically.
4. After countdown, the game starts.
5. You can get the daily reward when you get 5 stars (match count).
6. You can get the special reward when you get 140 stars (match count) in total. You should receive the daily and special rewards before the event is over.
7. After the event is over, top 100 players are able to receive their ranking reward until September 14 (Pacific Time) in the page.

notes.title: NEW MODE. SAVE THE EARTH!
notes.content:
[h1][NEW MODE : SAVE THE EARTH!][/h1]

Defeat Alien invader’s U.F.O and SAVE THE EARTH!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/b8dbf572b072f8c95e9cafeb04e4f79343afcc77.png[/img]

[b][HOW TO START][/b]

YOU CAN SELECT MUSIC BY DEDICATED MUSIC SELECTION UI

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/2e2a80f458816295978fc565f67ebcda9f7c075f.png[/img]

You need at least 4 players to start a game.
And game is run on a dedicated stage to defeat the U.F.O.

[b][HOW TO ATTACK U.F.O][/b]

The GOAL of this mode is DESTROY 5 LASERS of U.F.O and SAVE the earth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/7d9ac43738ea1f7adab1290c08b7a43e74aa83b1.png[/img]
 
You can destroy the laser by all players score WOW.
Players score WOW launch missiles together and attack U.F.O.
Lasers are 3 types and getting more armor. So it becomes more difficult to destroy.
One tip is, More people attacks, it’s armor becomes lower.

[b][SUPER MISSILE][/b]

When you score WOW, you can see super missile on the right.
If you score WOW 5 times in a row, you can fire SUPER MISSILE!.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/146202a96f20134e3ec061c149949eaef7f33edc.png[/img] 

Super missile does critical attack. And inflict super damage 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/5f137594f799a2c49f44404856ea55d2fec5fbef.png[/img]

[b][FINAL BATTLE][/b]

When you destroy 4th Laser, FINAL BATTLE activates. And Alien’s hidden Weapon is revealed.
At final battle, If you don’t score WOW, you will be lifted into the air.
When you are lifted, you should skip next keynote. So please be careful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/65e1fb6b61c6aeca2f2d81794d7b6dab5221b7e9.png[/img]

[b][REWARD][/b]

Even if you couldn’t destroy all the lasers, you can receive earth defense bonus by how many lasers you destroyed.

If you destroyed all lasers and Successfully defended the earth, you can receive U.F.O Parts. 
There are 3 types of U.F.O parts. The more people you play, the more likely you are to collect medium and large parts.

[b][U.F.O Package][/b]

U.F.O parts are used to exchange “U.F.O package” At Exchange center.
You can visit Exchange center at my information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/d15c3d2eb849f399719d90034033363958094a88.png[/img]

notes.title: Challengers Open!
notes.content:
Challenge for 5 times everyday for 4 weeks, and get the Rare items & many rewards until June 9 (Pacific Time)!

[b]Summary of the rewards[/b]
- Daily Reward: Discount Coupon, Love/Double Power, Mutual Emotes, Seed, Pot, Couple Pose, VIP Room
- Special Reward: Rare items
- Ranking Reward: Free Coupon*, Fairytale Whale Egg, Permanent Hair/Pants/Shoes Coupon
*The free coupon can be exchanged for a permanent item.

[b]How do I join?[/b]
1. Go to "Challengers" page.
2. Click "Join" button on the bottom of the page.
3. When matching is done, you will enter to a room for the game automatically.
4. After countdown, the game starts.
5. You can get the daily reward when you get 5 stars (match count).
6. You can get the special reward when you get 140 stars (match count) in total. You should receive the daily and special rewards before the event is over.
7. After the event is over, top 100 players are able to receive their ranking reward until September 14 (Pacific Time) in the page.

notes.title: Challengers Open!
notes.content:
Challenge for 5 times everyday for 4 weeks, and get the Rare items & many rewards until June 9 (Pacific Time)!

[b]Summary of the rewards[/b]
- Daily Reward: Discount Coupon, Love/Double Power, Mutual Emotes, Seed, Pot, Couple Pose, VIP Room
- Special Reward: Rare items
- Ranking Reward: Free Coupon*, Fairytale Whale Egg, Permanent Hair/Pants/Shoes Coupon
*The free coupon can be exchanged for a permanent item.

[b]How do I join?[/b]
1. Go to "Challengers" page.
2. Click "Join" button on the bottom of the page.
3. When matching is done, you will enter to a room for the game automatically.
4. After countdown, the game starts.
5. You can get the daily reward when you get 5 stars (match count).
6. You can get the special reward when you get 140 stars (match count) in total. You should receive the daily and special rewards before the event is over.
7. After the event is over, top 100 players are able to receive their ranking reward until June 22 (Pacific Time) in the page.

notes.title: [ANNOUNCEMENT] TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON 2 WILL START.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/1c5e772fc426e25a6f80b1b9db7b4df780a19dce.png[/img]

THE TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON 2 
[PERIOD] : 2021.05.13 ~ 2021.05.19
[BASIC RULE : LEAGUE]
1. Everyday, Tournament will be open at 06:00 AM (Pacific Time)
2. The daily tournament results are recorded, and players who participated will receive points based on the results.
3. At the end of the league, they are ranked according to the total points of each player received.

[BASIC RULE : TOURNAMENT]
1. All players can enter the tournament channel 10 minutes before the tournament starts.
2. When the tournament begins, all players on the channel become tournament participants and will automatically enter the tournament.
3. Based on the number of participants, the total number of rounds in the tournament is automatically determined.
4. Rounds are divided into the Qualifier and the finals, and different rules apply.
5. In the qualifier round, all participants are sorted in order of score and the top players are selected after the game is over.
6. In the final rounds, such as round 64 and 32, the top players in each game will advance to the next round
7. In the final round, 8 players will play and top 3 players will be the winner of the tournament.

[ADDITIONAL RULES FOR TOURNAMENT]
1. You cannot leave the channel while registered as a tournament participant. 
2. If you leave the channel (including termination of connection or termination of the Lovebeat, etc), you will be excluded from the tournament.
3. After dropping out or enter tournament channel after the tournament starts, you can join a room as an observer or leave the channel freely.

[TOURNAMENT WINNER REWARD]
When a player win a tournament, the player will receive reward that last for a day.
1. When the player enter a waiting room, You will dance as a winner of tournament.
2. At waiting room, A trophy is shown besides your character’s name.

[LEAGUE WINNER REWARD]
 
[BASIC REWARD]
1. Each participants will be rewarded as their total points earned.
2. The Reward will be sent to users at the next maintenance after tournament league is over.
3. REWARDS ARE NOT CUMULATIVE
4. Higher place winner don’t receive 

REWARD LIST
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/d1a802966caf7a501b8f2d685106fe787ff6ea9c.png[/img]

[ADDITIONAL REWARD]
1. This reward can be awarded multiple times. Therefore you can still receive these rewards even if you have received basic reward.
2. All winners will receive a “Discount Coupon Box2” as a reward.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/7d5dcdc23bd1989d3aa013e569b75081d9851fcd.png[/img]

Thank you for playing Lovebeat. And we hope you enjoy “TOURNAMENT LEAGUE SEASON 2”.

Regards.
GM Lovebeat.

notes.title: [NOTICE] PRESENTING ILLEGAL ITEM ISSUE
notes.content:
Dear Players.

Recently, There was a problem at gifting item function. Misusing service vulnerability.

This caused following problems.
1. Abusers were ranked at the top of the “Weekly Popularity Ranking”
2. It made players puzzled.

We deeply apologize to you.

We will do as following.
1. We will fix the weakness. We will make our service more stable.
2. Through investigation, discovered abusers are suspended. Additional investigation is ongoing. Abusers will be suspended as soon as discovered.

To avoid unnecessary damage, we ask players to following cooperation.
1. If you receive a gift from unknown player, please leave the mail at the mailbox.
2. If you notice GM about the gift, it will be faster and safer.

notes.title: NEW MODE. SAVE THE EARTH!
notes.content:
[h1][NEW MODE : SAVE THE EARTH!][/h1]

Defeat Alien invader’s U.F.O and SAVE THE EARTH!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/a71b163898b92ac8acd4cf672bf390baf52eb283.png[/img] 


[b][HOW TO START][/b]

YOU CAN SELECT MUSIC BY DEDICATED MUSIC SELECTION UI

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/2e2a80f458816295978fc565f67ebcda9f7c075f.png[/img]

You need at least 4 players to start a game.
And game is run on a dedicated stage to defeat the U.F.O.

[b][HOW TO ATTACK U.F.O][/b]

The GOAL of this mode is DESTROY 5 LASERS of U.F.O and SAVE the earth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/7d9ac43738ea1f7adab1290c08b7a43e74aa83b1.png[/img]
 
You can destroy the laser by all players score WOW.
Players score WOW launch missiles together and attack U.F.O.
Lasers are 3 types and getting more armor. So it becomes more difficult to destroy.
One tip is, More people attacks, it’s armor becomes lower.

[b][SUPER MISSILE][/b]

When you score WOW, you can see super missile on the right.
If you score WOW 5 times in a row, you can fire SUPER MISSILE!.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/146202a96f20134e3ec061c149949eaef7f33edc.png[/img] 

Super missile does critical attack. And inflict super damage 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/5f137594f799a2c49f44404856ea55d2fec5fbef.png[/img]

[b][FINAL BATTLE][/b]

When you destroy 4th Laser, FINAL BATTLE activates. And Alien’s hidden Weapon is revealed.
At final battle, If you don’t score WOW, you will be lifted into the air.
When you are lifted, you should skip next keynote. So please be careful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/65e1fb6b61c6aeca2f2d81794d7b6dab5221b7e9.png[/img]

[b][REWARD][/b]

Even if you couldn’t destroy all the lasers, you can receive earth defense bonus by how many lasers you destroyed.

If you destroyed all lasers and Successfully defended the earth, you can receive U.F.O Parts. 
There are 3 types of U.F.O parts. The more people you play, the more likely you are to collect medium and large parts.

[b][U.F.O Package][/b]

U.F.O parts are used to exchange “U.F.O package” At Exchange center.
You can visit Exchange center at my information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/d15c3d2eb849f399719d90034033363958094a88.png[/img]

notes.title: Challengers Event Open!
notes.content:
Challenge for 5 times everyday for 4 weeks, and get the Rare items & many rewards until December 30 (Pacific Time)!

[b]Summary of the rewards below:[/b]
- Daily Reward: Discount Coupon, Love/Double Power, Mutual Emotes, Seed, Pot, Couple Pose, VIP Room
- Special Reward: Rare items
- Ranking Reward: Free Coupon*, Fairytale Whale Egg, Permanent Hair/Pants/Shoes Coupon
*The free coupon can be exchanged for a permanent item.

[b]How do I join?[/b]
1. Go to "Challengers" page.
2. Click "Join" button on the bottom of the page.
3. When matching is done, you will enter to a room for the game automatically.
4. After countdown, the game starts.
5. You can get the daily reward when you get 5 stars (match count).
6. You can get the special reward when you get 140 stars (match count) in total. You should receive the daily and special rewards before the event is over.
7. After the event is over, top 100 players are able to receive their ranking reward until September 3 (Pacific Time) in the page.

notes.title: New Content, “Fam Occupation” UPDATE!
notes.content:
Fam competition content “Fam Occupation” is updated and open until November 4 @10PM (Pacific Time)!

[!!FAM OCCUPATION UPDATE!!] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/02f3cbe8eed13c4a90ce2592daec14d5b6c46309.png[/img]

[b]WHAT IS FAM OCCUPATION?[/b]
For limited period, conquer tiles as many as you can. And acquire ‘POINT’. A FAM with most point wins.

[b]CONDITION TO JOIN[/b]
If you want to join, you should satisfy these condition.
CAN JOIN : 
-. Anyone who joined to a Fam.
CAN NOT JOIN :
 -. Someone who joined a Fam after “Fam Occupation” starts.
 -. Someone who changes(include quit/ban/disband ) a Fam.

[b]HOW TO JOIN[/b]
Click Fam occupation Icon and activate “Fam Occupation” page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/ffeeaed47eb7cc1fbdee0e35c91d13b52b756653.png[/img]
Click this icon at menu.

[b]PROCESS OF FAM OCCUPATION[/b]
Fam Occupation repeats every week during the period.
FAM OCCUPATION STARTS : Every Thursday 18:00
FAM OCCUPATION ENDS : Every Sunday 23:00
RECEIVE REWARDS : From Monday 00:00 to Tuesday 23:00

[b]RECEIVING TICKETS[/b]
10 tickets will be charged 00:00 every day during the period. Unused tickets expire before charging. Please use it. You can have a maximum of 10 tickets.

[b]HOW TO PLAY[/b]
At map, you can check Occupation status real time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/b48565013ba3a4d18317a4369841f2480ded9151.jpg[/img]

Not Occupied
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/3d899a20d0c165e4e5999e116e81fbfe0ebb4b62.png[/img]

Occupied by our FAM
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/33d6194d0bf4ad6e8713161bdc66c5d0cbe49706.png[/img]

Occupied by other FAM
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/775ee2231f02c6fa4b7641ec6734c435753c6be7.png[/img]


[b]HOW TO CHECK OCCUPYING CONDITION[/b]
When you click a tile, You can check Tile’s condition to conquer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/2fb19582cfe8b8f14ce9fda30379f55f742e9ce1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/743a7f7a965ce88c6cd743ed08c662eb4b3861d8.png[/img]

[b]HOW TO CHECK OCCUPATION AVAILABLE TILE(ON/OFF)[/b]
Click “Not occupied” button at right menu to toggle. On/Off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/a83a06e49f5aa57cf0734c2429d0fd0530973658.png[/img]

[b]FAM OCCUPATION WAITINGROOM[/b]
You can make Fam Occupation waitroom when this condition is met.
-. You should be able to join Fam Occupation.
-. You should have enough LEVEL to try.
-. You should have tickets equal to or greater than the tile’s required tickets..

If your fam member make a waitingroom for fam occupation, you can enter th room. (You should have enough level and tickets too).

[b]OCCUPATION SUCCESS/FAIL[/b]
At result screen, you will know Occupation was successful.

[b]OCCUPATION POINT[/b]
- When you are successful, you receive ‘Occupation Point’.
- If you lost a tile to another Fam, you will lost received ‘Occupation Point’ 
- There is two kind of Occupation Point.
-. Tile Occupation Point : Point for each Tile.
-. Area Occupation Bonus : When you occupy a group of tile, you will receive ‘Area Occupation Bunus’. There is 14 group.

[b]RANKING[/b]
- Ranking Calculation
 -. When Fam Occupation ends, Ranking will be calculated.
 -. Ranking is determined by total Occupation Point 
-. When you score a tie
  -. In this case. These Fam are count as ‘Lowest rank’ of their point.
    Example : When Fam ‘A’ scores 50 and Fam ‘B’, ‘C’ scores 35. They are ranked as 3rd place. Not 2nd


[b]REWARD[/b]
You will receive rewards as below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/194ae9e8da4da442abb06ef3f651d8b7346e6dc4.png[/img]

You can get one if these from Accessory Box (rare)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/e794dd19c9370942b9e0cc82fa158e4b96466476.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/f87724575672890dd22ca845fd344d043369d601.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/24308bcf629339027a723e57965a6f444a97757f.png[/img]

[b]NOTICE[/b]
When you are detected as an abuser or is using hack, your account and Fam members can be imposed sanctions. Please be careful and play fair.

notes.title: NEW MODE “DEFEAT WIND DJINN” OPEN!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/021691484c0393c6847fe979157f37ad0f40611a.png[/img]

[b]< OVERCOME STORM, DEFEAT WIND DJINN! >[/b]

Stormy new mode, “Defeat Wind Djinn” just arrived!

If you Successfully defeat Wind Djinn, You can get material for treasure box.
 

So. Do you want to know how to? 
Let me show you how to.


[h1][HOW TO PLAY][/h1]

[b]1.	Get a ticket [/b]

You can get a ticket at shop. 
( At September 2 update, every character will receive one as gift )
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/81d5e54d7a3efbb9f0cf0a609589bc695ac6d7b4.png[/img]

[b]2.	Create room[/b]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/c47dc47e7265ef231650867766a553672194da57.png[/img]

When you have ticket, you can select “Defeat Wind Djinn” mode at create room.

[Lobby → Create a game room→ Game Mode → Defeat Wind Djinn]
[b]*You can see when you have Wind Djinn ticket only.[/b]

 
[b]3.	Select Music and Difficulty.[/b]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/af8a85f31e86968f025c76b66972bc005534b741.png[/img]

Select Music
Difficulty is set automatically by selected music.

~* Mode difficulty by music *~

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/fe9e28aabed56c991cc580fa04a959cd046a8ad8.png[/img]

 
[h1][How to Defeat Wind Djinn][/h1]

[b]By Wind Djinn’s condition, you may pushed away and may drop from cliff[/b]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/e301340cc363c70d8f9b2c02a65cc505954003c3.png[/img]
 

If a player score WOW, “DASH TIME” guage will be filled.
If guage is full, “Dash Time” happens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/1629811ece0cbf8e171f7128e030500c15244d83.png[/img]
 
[b]At dash time, there is no arrow key, but you should hit space fast.[/b]
Your character will go forward by guage.

[b]Every 3 times of Dash Time, Wind djinn gets angrier.[/b]
As anger step of Wind djinn, You should get a verdict, or pushed away.
If any of your team drops from cliff, Immediately mission fails and playing ends..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/d420b368693063f40a900800827c77d447ecf3a0.png[/img]

[b]If all players get to Sealed Stone before music ends, you’ve Defeated Wind djinn.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/630c778b79761c1c6df91cfa7eeb991bd8c1d8f7.png[/img]

[b]When it is successful, you can flip card to select rewards.[/b]
If you don’t flip, automatically selected
Number of material is determined randomly and delivered to your inventory.

[h1][How to exchange reward.][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/4c7a413f0f6e5d63db6b150dcbb6f451ede98582.png[/img]

[b]At “My Information”, you can visit exchange center.[/b]
If you have enough material, you can exchange with treasure box.

[h1][ REWARDS ][/h1]

When you exchange item, you can get one of these items at random.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/6ca58686fa28509844d731c782367873ee270f31.png[/img]

notes.title: New Feature, “Auto Translation”!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/56c6c3869385672bab3641ec3c21ace9445a6e3e.png[/img]

We have prepared for a long time for players who are having trouble talking to users who speak other languages.

From this update, We start service named “Premium Chat”!

Using this feature, you can set your language. “Premium Chat” will translate chat and shouts to your language.

[How to use Premium Chat]
1.	At top of your chat window, your language selection is shown.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/649525dbcad54ae8ae77007f52bf1a43d1193395.png[/img]

You can change language selection by just clicking them.

2.	After set, all chat messages will translate into selected language.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/39665ca2dca33c8a3a0a6feed5a477de902ef9da.png[/img]

 
[Notice]
1.	“Premium Chat“ is using translation engine. Due to translation engine’s limit, there can be  mistranslation.
2.	Price and Function of “Premium Chat” are subject to change by policy.
3.	When misusing “Premium Chat” is detected, the user can be limited to play Lovebeat.

notes.title: "MAGIC DYE" UPDATED!
notes.content:
[h1][ NEW FEATURE, MAGIC DYE! ][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/0c3edd2b65c7df47d958e0b668cc421e271d48ff.png[/img]

< With Magic Dye, You can dye an item with special Color! >

Now, use unnecessary dye to make Magic dye! 
 
1.	How to make Magic Dye
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/8322aed586fd6fd7e43061fa3d8d400e9beaa679.png[/img]
 
You can get Magic dye by [b]creation Only[/b]

↓ Here is creation procedure. ↓
①	Go to [Inventory ▶ General ▶ Function] and click “Mysterious paint”. It will open creation window.
②	Select a dye to consume.
③	Click “Create” Button.

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/dc407cf702133b82cd137379d9633ff00f337056.png[/img]

Creation is complete just after you click “Create”. This will consume 1 mysterious paint and 1 dye of your choice. And 1 magic dye will be sent to your Inventory immediately.
 
2.	How to use Magic dye.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/8c71b4d73453c55145fcbc3ef8da314b399a25dc.png[/img] 

You can check which item is usable for “Magic Dye” at tooltip.
Magic Dye can be used like other dye.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/bfff470fc3ac39627718731507a47b9404a22a75.png[/img]

But not like other dye, 
Magic Dye is dyed [b]randomly[/b]
To normal color or [b]Rare Color(5%) [/b]

※ Rare color is unique for each item as Special pattern or color

We will update fashion items with rare colors.
Thank you.

notes.title: Challengers Event Open!
notes.content:
Challenge for 5 times everyday for 4 weeks, and get the Rare items & many rewards until August 20 (Pacific Time)!

[b]Summary of the rewards below:[/b]
- Daily Reward: Discount Coupon, Love/Double Power, Mutual Emotes, Seed, Pot, Couple Pose, VIP Room
- Special Reward: Rare items
- Ranking Reward: Free Coupon*, Fairytale Whale Egg, Permanent Hair/Pants/Shoes Coupon
*The free coupon can be exchanged for a permanent item.

[b]How do I join?[/b]
1. Go to "Challengers" page.
2. Click "Join" button on the bottom of the page.
3. When matching is done, you will enter to a room for the game automatically.
4. After countdown, the game starts.
5. You can get the daily reward when you get 5 stars (match count).
6. You can get the special reward when you get 140 stars (match count) in total. You should receive the daily and special rewards before the event is over.
7. After the event is over, top 100 players are able to receive their ranking reward until September 3 (Pacific Time) in the page.

notes.title: Treasure Hunt Renewal & Trade system Update
notes.content:
Treasure hunt has been renewed and Trade system updated.

[h1]Treasure Hunt Renewal[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/d300d8bde6afb87f9d8eea94f5323a9c26809e76.png[/img]

[b]- Number of treasure materials increased to 60.
- Treasure is changed.
- Special treasure that gives ‘Rare’!
- Hints for new materials[/b]
 - Stamps.
 - Flower garden seeds.
 - game mode
 - Magic wardrobe.
 - Lovetree
 - Producer tranee mission
 - attendance bonus.
 - Level up bonus
 - Material Randombox


[h1]Trade System Update[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/9965aae8c603db5ae9d619eefa79f1bc00cf1848.png[/img]

- Trade System is…
  Trading system between treasure materials and ‘heart’

[b]How To Trade[/b]
[b]1. At waiting room, click and select trade. When opponent accept, trade pop up opens.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/8cce09421336078c50db736077b42fbc8db51191.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/bbc8e659e53870550e5a99fc18037478eeaf434a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/dc734106fcb5d913011afab71da001384f92e2f2.png[/img]

[b]2. Select trading items.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/d2e264ed7fcd622f412f4d163fda62110c538661.png[/img]

[b]3. When you trade material, Please select material and number.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/90645a185af80bfc303ee5488ab0939c4cdf5173.png[/img]

[b]4. If you trade heart, please input number of hearts.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/1f76fd9e12fec68994a0b67b583e3c09e7511236.png[/img]

[b]5. when items are selected correctly, Click ‘Item Lock’ Button.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/1d5c4f2190b0916bf640112019cee962f11820cc.png[/img]

[b]6. When Both user do Item Lock, ‘Make deal’ button activates.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/bbe53b546eefd3f2390398d888274cec54e973b6.png[/img]

[b]7. After both player agree deal, trade ends.[/b]

Before trade, Don’t forget trading fee!

1. For each slot, 5 heart will be charged as fee
2. Trade fee increases proportionally by number of registered heart. (15% as fee)
3. Only buyer pays trade fee.
4. When trade is done, trade fee is reduced before heart is sent to the other.

notes.title: New Feature “Fashion Week”
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/7d77aceae97bb6878901654d4c536de988b7f752.png[/img]


< Introduce new Feature “Fashion Week!” >

Fashioin Week is an event of competing fashion sense of the characters you coordinated tailored to the given theme.

[b]Schedule[/b]
[list]
[*] Pre-registration: 2020.05.27(After MA) ~ 2020.06.10 (Before MA)
[*] Season Start: 2020.06.10 (After MA)~
[*] registration: Everyday 00:00 ~ 05:00 (While in season)
[*] Vote : Everyday 05:00 ~ 10:00 (While in season)
[*] Season End: 2020.07.08 (Before MA)
[/list]

[b]Registration[/b]
[list]
[*] You can apply by fashion week button
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/9de6f4dea8c5d9965e5919ba64e6de03181e94e9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/fadaa3f61fc670e8f3c3f81641388b9a257b03de.png[/img]
[list]
[*] When you click Change Style button, you move to set style.
[*] In Pre registration period, you can only change style and apply.
[*] You can change style anytime even after changing Style. Please feel free to apply anytime!
[*] You don’t need to apply everyday. Once you apply, you are applied to whole fashion week.
[/list]

[b]Changing Style[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/caeff6040fd312a79f961c71d2539ce95c7c799e.png[/img]
[list]
[*] In fashion week. You can change style for free and apply 
[*] If you set styles with your own item, you will get bonus fashion week point.
[/list]


[Bonus points by setting with your own item]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/35bac8bfc3241221b8b8fbf18670acdbb8aea0af.png[/img]

[b]Applying [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/05dffa0c360750bc24abe9f056efe90b4f168f2d.png[/img] 
[list]
[*] When you confirm, applying is over.
[/list]

[b]Voting[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/b4e3b54a9bf127968492429c0d81677d32df34f6.png[/img]

[b]Vote ticket[/b]
[list]
[*] Vote ticket is given up to 30.
[*] Tickets are charged every 10 minutes and you can have up to 5 tickets at a time.
[/list]
[b]Select Like it![/b]
[list]
[*] Please click Like it button at the one you prefer.
[*] When you click, you and the one you voted both get fashioin week point 
[*] You can purchase special items at reward shop. So don’t forget to vote!
[/list]
[b]Pass[/b]
[list]
[*] If you don’t like both coordination, you can choose passing to next attendee.
[*] If you choose to pass, vote ticket doesn’t be used.
[*] You can pass only 5 times a day.
[/list]

[b]Ranking[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/14d4763e9e206c513aab9a8da2cb70b891e97621.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Everyday, rank is renewed by vote.
[*] Top 100 characters will get additional fashion week point as Bonus.
[/list]

[b]Reward Shop[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11028929/a24cf50d55fac8d3d9ca0ba06591fb5ad0edaa59.png[/img]

[list]
[*] You can spend fashion week point to purchase rewards.
[*] Fashion week point is reset before next season. So DON’T FORGET to use fashion point!
[/list]

notes.title: Challengers Event Grand Open!
notes.content:
Challenge for 5 times everyday for 4 weeks, and get the Rare items & many rewards until May 14 (Pacific Time)!

Summary of the rewards below:
- Daily Reward: Discount Coupon, Love/Double Power, Mutual Emotes, Seed, Pot, Couple Pose, VIP Room
- Special Reward: Rare items
- Ranking Reward: Free Coupon*, Fairytale Whale Egg, Permanent Hair/Pants/Shoes Coupon
*The free coupon can be exchanged for a permanent item.

How do I join?
1. Go to "Challengers" page.
2. Click "Join" button on the bottom of the page.
3. When matching is done, you will enter to a room for the game automatically.
4. After countdown, the game starts.
5. You can get the daily reward when you get 5 stars (match count).
6. You can get the special reward when you get 140 stars (match count) in total. You should receive the daily and special rewards before the event is over.
7. After the event is over, top 100 players are able to receive their ranking reward until May 14 (Pacific Time) in the page.

notes.title: Hotfix 02.03.2020
notes.content:
We updated a game to fix an error which the game doesn't run. [b]Please restart the Steam client to download this update.[/b]

[h1]Patch Note[/h1]
1. Fixed an error which the game doesn't run.

[h1]If the problem persists after this update[/h1]
Please try our basic troubleshooting as in following:

[b]1. Run Windows and Steam as an administrator:[/b]
- How to:
  A. Windows Admin.
    1) Select “Start” and type “CMD“.
    2) Right-click “Command Prompt” then choose “Run as administrator“.
    3) If prompted, enter a username and password that grants admin rights to the computer.
    4) Type: net user administrator /active:yes
    5) Press “Enter“.
  B. [b]Steam[/b]
    1) Right-click Steam
    2) Run it as an administrator
[b]2. End unnecessary programs and [b]anti-virus programs.[/b]
3. Allow the game through Windows Firewall.
4. Update your Windows and graphic drivers up to dated.
5. Delete a GameGuard folder located in LoveBeat installation directory.[/b]

If your issue doesn't resolve with the troubleshooting above, please submit your information to [u]lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr[/u]:

[b]a. Steam account
b. LoveBeat avatar's name (if you have)
c. Detailed description of your problem
d. Screenshot or videos showing your problem (if available)
e. DxDiag.txt[/b]
 - How to create it?
   1) Press Windows Key + R.
   2) Type DxDiag and press Enter.
   3) In the DxDiag window, click Save All Information.
   4) Name the file "dxdiag" and click Save.
   5) Exit the DirectX Diagnostic Tool.
[b]f. GameGuard.zip[/b]
  - How to create it?
   1) Navigate to your LoveBeat installation directory
   2) Right-click on GameGuard folder
   3) Hover your cursor over the “Send to” option. it will open a new submenu
   4) Select “Compressed (zipped) folder”

notes.title: [Content Guide] Produce 7
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/f06f9bc66bf43d071f9655d0872f28a0949fb6f0.png[/img]
Hello, Dancers!
It’s time to debut and be a Celebrity! Produce 7 is the customized contents for you.
High Level Dancers! Be a Producer and cast Trainees.
New Dancers! Don’t be shy and just apply to be a trainee. With other Trainees and your Producer will help you.
To be a Celebrity, just follow my lead~


[h1][b]Trainee[/b][/h1]
Only Dancers below level 15 can be a Trainee.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/7b4cba6beb12bce69f5d9b8a2d5f05dc13f51468.png[/img]
[b]How to Apply[/b]
You can select a Producer from Producer screen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/fa9785a4968118c1770465798c81bd1835da51c2.png[/img]

[b]Mission[/b]
You can find Missions at the left side of Waiting room.
Training Missions are available only when you are Trainee.
If you clear Trainee Mission, can get Training Point and could be more skilled higher rank Trainee(Max. S).
Don’t hesitate to be a Trainee, Produce7 help your growth.


[h1][b]Producer[/b][/h1]
Only Dancer over level 30 can be a Producer.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/da794208fe30094ff2ade881df1978d587ea4b16.png[/img]

[b]Cast[/b]
Producer can cast max. 7 Trainees.
Mouse over and click applicant, then you can find the command “Cast”.

[b]Reward[/b]
Producer gets EXP and Beat from Trainees.
Hard Trainees will give you more EXP and Beats.
Take care your Trainees and be a friends of them.
Keep in touch with your lucky 7 Trainees and raise your reputation!

[b]Release Trainees[/b]
Producers! Do you want to know how to KICK lazy Trainees from your list?
There is a way.
"/release [nickname]"
And I'm looking for another way to help the way to release trainees by system. But it will take more time.

Produce7 is waiting for your Debut.

notes.title: [Updated] GameGuard Error Issue
notes.content:
The issue's been revised. Please check if you can access to the client. If you're having the same problem, please contact LoveBeat Support: lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr for the assistance. Thank you!



Good day, Dancers!

Recently, some of the players are having a GameGuard issue when playing.
We're now figuring out the way to fix the problem, but it may take some time to find the cause.
If you see the error message 'GameGuard initialization error: 230' while playing the game, please contact our Support with your 'GameGuard.zip' file.

Here is the sample of error message pops up.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/c1c3f8aad702c9ba8ebc942ce6465caf3f3ae418.jpg[/img]

[h1]Please refer below information for self-solution[/h1]
• please try below to make sure if there’s no process that might cause disconnection while playing LoveBeat.
• Please close the unrelated program/process when open the LoveBeat client.
• Please update the vaccine program you’re using the latest version.
• If the same issue happens repeatedly, please temporally inactive your vaccine program, and check if the same issue still happens.

[h1]How to create GameGuard. zip?[/h1]
1) Navigate to your LoveBeat installation directory: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\LoveBeat
2) Right-click on GameGuard folder
3) Hover your cursor over the “Send to” option. it will open a new submenu
4) Select “Compressed (zipped) folder”

[h1]Contact to LoveBeat Support[/h1]
- lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr
- Please don't forget to attach the 'GameGuard.zip' file for the faster processor

We're very sorry for the inconvenience, and will try to fix the issue as soon as possible.
Thank you.

notes.title: [Last Updated: Mar 8] Conversations with GM
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/ac795a3afd888cd21f4c1db21bc7ae3fc4734bb8.png[/img]

Hello, Dancers!

You know the event 'Conversations with GM' is opened for Feb 22 to Mar 7!
The replies from GMs will be keep updated in this post :D
You can suggest and ask anything about LoveBeat either this posting or the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/354290/announcements/detail/2621529181148431034]event posting[/url].

Please kindly understand that some of the opinions might not be introduced below, if they are duplicated or very similar to other suggestions :)

[h1]Introducing your suggestions ːKissingLalabitː[/h1]
[olist][*][b]Lin[/b]
Do you plan on adding married couple story like PH had? Also it would be nice to have more different modes like in Audition online; here you always have one bar with arrows/spacebar.

ːJoyfulLalabitː [b]From GM[/b]
Hi, Lin! Thank you for your suggestion! You must be the player from PH server, welcome :) The Love/Married couple story will be added in LoveBeat Steam in near future, so please wait for the good news!
In addition, the new modes will be updated as well :) Thank you.

[*][b]☩Ｔσχιη☩[/b]
whats the point in offering the 100% coupons if you dont even get at least one. Not fair when I go out of my way to attend the stupid hot times. tbfh

ːJoyfulLalabitː [b]From GM[/b]
Good day, ☩Ｔσχιη☩ ! Believe me, the 100% coupon surely comes out from the Hot time box..! I wish a good luck to you ːKissingLalabitː

[*][b]ｊｕｓｔ ｍｅ[/b]
I've been seeing alot of Friendly Couple. I was thinking that maybe you could add in Friend Page or you can call it BFF page lol. And in that page will be you and your best friend, same features as couple page (story missions, bio, days, love tree, etc)

ːJoyfulLalabitː [b]From GM[/b]
Welcome to LoveBeat! Actually, we are also thinking of that kind of contents. Thank you for the suggestion, and we'll try to update in game asap! Thanks :D

[*][b]Aldondrius [/b]
Nothing was changed about the shout system, i can't disable them,
and the constant reminders each hour that i play, so annoying, i don't
even want to play anymore.
Also the time gauge kiss and dance is useless, i need to delete them,
what a waste when you can buy those with hearts anyway.
I got couple gifts i can't use, constant worthless things
that is just mocking me that i can't use, it is really disappointing.
The game crashes out with disconnect
Issues without even trying to reconnect first.

ːJoyfulLalabitː [b]From GM[/b]
Dear Aldondrius, thank you for your feedbacks on LoveBeat!
First of all, I'd like to say sorry for such inconvenience you felt while playing game ːSadLalabitː. So sorry about that.
For the ShoutOut issue, GMs are keep monitoring in-game, to prevent any chaos in Chatting. We're developing system to solve the ShoutOut issue, and it is planned to be updated during March :)
In addition, we'll try to update Playing Gauge reward regularly with more variety of items :) Please wait for that.
Out team keeps updating the revised client to reduce the game crash. However, there might be several points that cause the game crash :'( 
Please refer this post [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/354290/announcements/detail/1673522003709377736]'LoveBeat Support Guide for Disconnected Players'[/url] for the quick solution. If you are having the same problem even after checking all of them, please contact our support(lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr) for diagnosing.
Hope this helps out! Thank you for playing LoveBeat :)

[*][b]Concerns about Challengers[/b]
hello i have a concern about for the new event called challengers event , someone noticed that when you get dc or alt f4 when log in again after that dc or alt f4 u dont have a lose supposedly it will added to their lose but why it won't added ? only 5 minutes penalty. it's ok for someone who got dc but in alt f4 ? its a BIG NO ! its so UNFAIR !! a lot of players now if they know they will lose they will go alt f4 i tried it too to my dummy if its true yeah and its true its unfair to other players who play fair! i dont have a screenshot but u can try it with your own . Please i am begging to make the game battle fair make a move with this pls . Tnx

ːJoyfulLalabitː [b]From GM[/b]
I brought the concern of [b]Kriisten.[/b], but please know that this is also for all other dearest players who asked for Challengers event!
Many players reported that there are some players who keep dc game either intentionally or not :/ Our team also fully aware of such players, so we are now developing ways to figure out the abusers.
As you may know, there are also players who dc unintentionally due to the bad network, and other circumstances, we cannot cut everyone who disconnected while Challenging and give penalties. I know, it is sad :(
I appreciate all feedback you guys sent and will try to revise this event to satisfy everyone. Thank you.


[/olist]

The lists will be keep updated! Please stay tuned and talk with GM ^^
Thank you for playing LoveBeat, and your enthusiasm is a big contribution in LoveBeat.

XOXO, GMs ːKissingLalabitː

notes.title: [Notice] LoveBeat Policy on Game Abusing Cases
notes.content:
Hello, This is GM Beat.
Hope everyone's preparing for the wonderful start of the Spring.

Thanks to many players who love to play fair, we could revise the game policy on overall game abusing sanctions including fixed Fam battle.

The policies below are the new policy for in-game abusing and will be enforced from February. The sanctions against abusers have intensified. Please appreciate other players' right and cooperate for the clean LoveBeat.

[h1]Criterion of fixed Fam battles[/h1]
- In the following cases, it will be recognized as a fixed Fam battle. Please do not try any action that may be suspected as fixed.
1) Keep winning or losing Fam battles by forcibly quitting games in the middle of playing. Considering network problem, the standard for the sanctions has revised more rationally to minimize unfair treatments.
2) Keep winning or losing Fam battles by playing with certain Fam(s) only.

Penalties for fixed Fam battles
- 1st penalty: Fam point deduction from the fixed Fam battles
- 2nd penalty: Withdrawal of all Fam points
- 3rd penalty: Compulsory disband the Fam

[h1]Sanctions for illegal program detection[/h1]
- Using a program that has not been officially released to take advantages of the game will be subjected to sanctions.
1) Penalties for Manipulating game plays
- 1st penalty: 7 days of account suspension
- 2nd penalty: Permanent account suspension

2) Penalty for using cash or item operation program
- 1st penalty: Withdrawal of all items and cash gained illegally.
If it is impossible to withdraw all of them, the account will be permanently suspended.
The same penalty will be given to the player who received illegally gained items as an in-game gift.

[h1]Inappropriate Chattings and nicknames[/h1]
Inappropriate or offensive chats and Nickname include Swearing, cursing, porn, hacking, racism, drugs, and the words others may feel discomfort.
This also contains chatting or Shoutout by repeating same chats that give disapproval to others.
1) Penalties for inappropriate chattings
- 1st penalty: Block chatting for 7 days
- 2nd penalty: Block chatting for 14 days
- 3rd penalty: 7 days of account suspension

2) Penalties for inappropriate nicknames
- 1st penalty: Forces to change Nickname with an offer of ‘Name change’ item
- 2nd penalty: Forces to change Nickname (will be no provision of ‘Name change’ item)

Depending on the level of its transgression, more severe sanctions can be enacted to the offenders. For any concern and dispute, please email LoveBeat Support(lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr) for the resolution. Revocation is possible if you can confirm that the issue was not intentional. However, we are not responsible for any inquiry disadvantages occurred by restriction.

If you have any concern or suggestion, please feel free to contact our Support and GMs.
Thank you for your cooperation.

notes.title: [Notice] Announcement on Fixed Fam Battles Sanction
notes.content:
Hello Dancers, this is GM Beat.

Thank you for playing and loving LoveBeat. I'd like to express a deep appreciation on behalf of our LoveBeat team.

The sanction policy is being implemented at all times in order to eradicate the unfair play in LoveBeat. After the implementation of the sanctions in December, there was a lot of opinions and questions from players regarding the policy. In order to solve the curiosity of players, we’ve decided to make this announcement.


[h1]1. Why were the existing policies not applied?[/h1]

First of all, I’d like to make an excuse for the reason why the existing policies were not applied to December sanction.

As you may know, the existing rules are as follows: 1. Warning to Fam Master, 2. Fam points deduction, and 3. Initializing Fam Grade and Points. However, on December’s sanction, the existing policy had not enforced to the Fam who got the 3rd penalty, and it continued to a suspicion that the policy has been adjusted for the convenience of certain Fam.

As to the conclusion, the revised policy has not been adjusted for the convenience of a particular Fam.

The reason for the implementation of the different policy in December is that the subjected Fam had achieved over Fam Grade 11, which the special Fam reward item is given. Therefore, if the Fam grade is initialized, the possibility of receiving the special reward for duplicated times has raised.

As a result, we are discussing new policies to prevent various side effects, and the sanction in December couldn’t follow the existing policy. We deeply apologize for the inability to inform you in advance.


[h1]2. About the Revision of the December Sanctions[/h1]

After the enforcement of the provisional policy, there were many feedbacks from players regarding the operation of fixed Fam Battles. Thanks to this, we confirmed that the external influence such as the user’s network environment can be influenced in recording manipulated games.

Some of the Fams were asked to re-confirm on their records, and the conditions that might influence on Fam record have noticed. Therefore, we decided to cancel the penalties have been informed in December.

As a result, the first sanctioned Fams will receive a warning cancellation, and the Fams who got more than 2 times of penalties will get the deducted points back on the Jan 25th update.


[h1]3. The Direction and Standard of Sanctions for Fixed Fam Battle[/h1]

We are discussing a new policy for fixed Fam Battle that prevents the side effects of the old policy. The new policy should be acceptable to the majority of users and expected to be enforced in January. After then, we strongly encourage not to take any action that could be suspected as a fixed Fam Battle, and it may lead to intense sanctions. Please noted.


You can send an email to [u]lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr[/u] about irrational conduct. If it is not intentional, the sanction may be withdrawn, but disadvantages occurred are not responsible for penalties incurred.

Thank you for your understanding in advance.

notes.title: [Complete] Maintenance & Patch Note on December 28, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/ddb64fa835e29b7766832bb15de3444730267014.png[/img]
Hello, Dancers.
We will be performing scheduled maintenance to update and provide a better service.
During this time the game will be unavailable for play.

[h1]Date and time[/h1]
[strike]Dec 27, 2017 @ 9:00 PM-Midnight (Pacific Time, UTC-8)
Dec 28, 2017 @ 6:00 AM - 9:00 AM (Central European Time, UTC+1)

[list][*]New Items
[list][*]61 parts, 52 accessories, 5 set items will be added

[*]New Garden Items
[list][*]2 Flowerpots, 2 Seeds, and 2 garden skins added
[*]Get more exp and beat bonus![/list]

[*]New Songs
[list][*]Small Back Room by Moira Waugh
[*]Vision(Produced by Golden Day) by Kellee Maize
[*]Sunny Indie Pop by RogerThat
[*]Go Away by The.madpix.project
[*]Fill the Space by Wordsmith[/list]

[*]Fixes and other changes
[list][*]Notice banners changed
[*]Effect bug from 'Beat Pang Pang' mode has fixed
[*]HOT music and item lists changed[/list][/list]

[h1]Ongoing Event[/h1]
[list][*][url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/354290/announcements/detail/1601458706074366927]New & Ongoing Event (Dec 28 - Jan 10, Pacific Daylight Time)[/url][/list]

Thank you!

notes.title: [End] Announcement on Daily Quest Event
notes.content:
Hello Dancers!

The bugs on Daily Quests have been noticed.
Since there are 2 identical quests on Daily Quest list for Nov 30 and Dec 1 (PST), only 4 quests are available to complete on Live right now.
I apologize for such issue ːSadLalabitː

As you may know, 'Clear the Daily Quests' event is now on, so some of you might be worried about the event condition.

[h1]Quests Duplicated (PST)[/h1]
[b]- Nov 30 'Relax your fingers'
- Dec 1 'A Beat pioneer'[/b]

The duplicated quests will be counted to be cleared if you finish any of them.
For example, there are 2 'Relax your fingers' on Nov 30, so if you clear one of this quest, it will be cumulated as 2 quests cleared when receiving a reward after the event.
Therefore, if you cleared all 8 quests on both Nov 30 and Dec 1, they will be counted total 10 quests, so no worries on event reward!

Below is the event condition. Please check it :D

[b]Clear the Daily Quests![/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/4392b8b6d0bd429fc891c0a1916b9b48227639ef.png[/img]
Clear the daily quests and get rewards! 
According to the number of quests you clear during the event period, the extra gifts will be given!
[list][*][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/a10e81462a2d655cfc12eeb8a6ebf03ce5ec8cc1.png[/img][/list]
[list]The hints for Mr. MysteryQ will be posted every day on our FaceBook Page! Check out and you don't wanna miss it ːsteamhappyː
[*][url=https://www.facebook.com/LovebeatEnglishVersion/]Go to LoveBeat FaceBook[/url][/list]


Thank you for the cooperation in advance, and I hope you all to enjoy LoveBeat!

Thank you.

New & ongoing events for you. Check out this post to learn more

[h1]Events (Pacific Daylight Time)[/h1]
1. Halloween Costume Package (Oct 19 - Nov 1)
2. Double Cash Bonus with Special Gifts (Oct 19 - Nov 1)
3. From 50% to 60%, Item Sales (Oct 19 - Nov 1)
4. Halloween Events (Oct 19 - Nov 1)
[list][*]Zombie Mode
[*]Login Event
[*]Golden Time Event
[*]Hot Time Event[/list]
5. Autumn Exclusive Unique Titles (Oct 19 - Nov 15)
6. Spend Cash and get a Wing Accessory! Season 2 (Sept 28 - Nov 1)
7. Monthly Perfect Attendance Award on October

[b]1. Halloween Costume Package[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/c537d5ad0d186c46db6e4f3128b2ad318d58cd47.png[/img]
A chance to get permanent Halloween Costumes at a 30% discounted price. Moreover, the permanent Halloween accessory will come together for free!
[list][*][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/8ee09b979bdabb638a111cd791469fe9e1d3deba.png]Check out at the store![/url][/list]

[b]2. Double Cash Bonus with Special Gifts[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/3c672d5bc28936174ae45947fbf001e93a663b94.png[/img]
During the event period, any first purchased cash will be doubled.
Don't miss the special gifts too!
[list][*]Check for the condition
1) The gifts and bonus cash will be given only [b]ONCE[/b] during the event period.
[u](ex. If your first charging amount was $19.99 and you charged $49.99 additional cash, only the bonus cash and Special gifts for $19.99 will be given.)[/u]
2) Amount of Bonus Cash and Special Gifts
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/4dc50ffc321cb2fc9ea1cbcfcfb1b03b4a894002.png[/img][/list]

[b]3. From 50% to 60%, Item Sales[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/428a3eb4c4d30a7413fb423418ea3ba23f7715e9.png[/img]
Get items at 50% to 60% discounted price!
Check for the sale lists at Store's 'Sale' Tab

[b]4. Halloween Events[/b]
[list][*][b]Zombie Mode Opens![/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/1d721f74d37a952b618dcea696cc78108fc2c569.png[/img]
Event mode 'Zombie Attack' opens for the Event period. Survive to the last and get doubled Exp and Beat!

[*][b]Halloween Login Event![/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/ac3fd5181f2e75675c23470ebdafb18a0d6e98f5.png[/img]
Login during the Halloween season and get assorted accessories!
[u]*Notice: All items are given in 'Teen Body' Type[/u][list]

[*][b]Event Period : Oct 30 - Nov 1 (PDT)[/b]
[list][*]Oct 30 : C Skull Head Acc (7 days)
[*]Oct 31 : Devil Set (7 days)
[*]Nov 1 : Devil Acc1 (7 days)[/list][/list][/list]

[*][b]Golden Time Event[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/b0bdc4ee51cf7e23accd6e52ba2c4bc3b28e6d2d.png[/img]
Play ANY mode at Golden Time and get extra beats, exp, and stars!
[list][*][u]Golden Times[/u]
[list][*]Every Fridays and Weekends
[*]05:00 - 06:00 AM (PDT)
[*]10:00 - 11:00 AM (PDT)
[*]18:00 - 19:00 PM (PDT)[/list]

[list][*]Fridays: Beats +444, Exp +666, and Star +1 per play
[*]Weekends: Beats +444, Exp +666, and Star +1 per play

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/96ce6003f2f0cdb7e6231f7a33b5ba939e637f07.png[/img]
Stay online for 15 mins and get Hot Time Boxes during the event period!
[list][*]Hot Times
[list][*]05:00 - 06:00 AM (PDT)
[*]10:00 - 11:00 AM (PDT)
[*]18:00 - 19:00 PM (PDT)[/list]

notes.title: [Completed] Maintenance & Patch Note on August 31, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/c1229aed0ff7841157a8a3f6ab204f9eb4cb248c.png[/img]
Hello, Dancers.
We will be performing scheduled maintenance to update and provide a better service.
During this time the game will be unavailable for play.

[h1]Date and time[/h1]
[strike]August 30, 2017 @ 10:00 PM - August 31, 1:00 AM (Pacific Daylight Time, UTC-7)
August 31, 2017 @ 6:00 AM - 9:00 AM (Central European Time, UTC+1)
August 31, 2017 @ 2:00 PM - 5:00 PM (Korea Time, UTC+9)
※ The time of maintenance might be changed depending on works.[/strike]
[b]※ The maintenance completed at 1:30 AM. Sorry for the inconvenience[/b]


[h1]Patch Note[/h1]
An update to LoveBeat will be released. The major changes include:
[list][*]New Rare item in Magic Wardrobe
[list][*]Rare item changed
[*][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/48013e23dff1b18486953faba9e255fc0242077c.png]Check Guardian Diana and Guardians Ring![/url]
Rares with special entering motion effect and Bonus. You can get until October 19th only![/list]
[b]*Notice: After the patch, you cannot get the [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/5489d2604d364988faf43239b81c88eefc713a22.png]Mermaid[/url]anymore.[/b]

[*]New Items
[list][*]74 Parts items, 10 accessories, 6 set items, and 1 balloon
[*]New VIP room [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/09dae5a92b24f8b11bb20ffc3c7bb0872cdb640c.png]'Romantic Lakeside'[/url]added.[/list]

[*]New Songs
[list][*]How to Dance in a Circle by Nabucco Dinosaur
[*]Each Love Story by Kara Square and Piero Peluche
[*]Dear Lucy by THE DADA WEATHERMAN
[*]Delightful Life by JEKK
[*]Energetic Indie Rock by GYMUSIC[/list]

[*]Fixes and other changes
[list][*]Notice banners changed
[*]Blocked users' mail will be blocked as well
[*]Item name and description of 'Rematch the battle' will be changed to 'Reset Battle Rewards'
[*]Game cutoff standard has changed to avoid abusers[/list][/list]

[h1]Ongoing Event[/h1]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/354290/announcements/detail/1443822371003789829]New & Ongoing Event (August 31 - September 13, Pacific Daylight Time)[/url]

Thank you!

notes.title: [Notice] LoveBeat Policy on fixed Fam battles
notes.content:
Hello, This is GM Love.

We are fully aware of the harmful effect of fixed Fam battles. For rooting it up, we constantly discussed it. Finally, its policy is decided although it took a long time. We will solve this problem by following measures quickly.

[b]Criterion of fixed Fam battles[/b]
- In the following cases, it will be recognized as a fixed Fam battle. Please do not try any action that may be suspected as fixed.
1) Keep winning or losing Fam battles by forcing quit games in the middle of that.
2) Keep winning or losing Fam battles by playing with certain Fam(s) only.

[b]Penalty for fixed Fam battles[/b]
- 1st penalty: Give a warning to the Fam’s master
- 2nd penalty: Deduct Fam points from the fixed Fam battles
- 3rd penalty: Initialize the Fam grade (make it level 1)

According to above policy, All of following Fams received a warning. (Here’s the Fam name and last 3 letters replaced with *.)

Eli***
Dinom***
Empi***
Eupho***
Black`S***
.*Silver`Sou***
Ni***

Depending on the level of its transgression, more severe sanctions can be enacted to the offenders. If you have any concern and dispute, you can email to LoveBeat Support(lovebeat_cs@crazydiamond.co.kr) for the resolution. Revocation is possible if you can confirm that the issue was not intentional. However, we are not responsible for any inquiry disadvantages occurred by restriction.

Apart from this policy, we found lots of actions that they get minimum score for rewards (Exp, Beat) and then don’t play anymore. We will change the minimum score higher to prevent this inappropriate acts on August 31 (Pacific Time).

Thank you for your cooperation.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/fb13a30d9f61fed6526beac978844a575d0332fc.png[/img]
Hello, Dancers! Check for the ongoing Summer Events! :JoyfulLalabit:
This event will be on from July 6th to 19th, before the maintenance. Never miss it!

[b]1. Golden Box Renewal![/b]
[list][*]Chance to get permanent Golden Wings at $2 Only![/list]

[b]2. 30% Paybacks on Evolution Pets![/b]
[list][*]Evolution pets are sold only in Permanent, and pet bonus intensify when they evolve to the next step![/list]

[b]3. Get Summer Exclusive Unique Titles!

4. Enjoy the Summer Time Gauge Event!

5. New Daily Gifts update!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/354290/announcements/detail/2383944632776928474]Check for the details and learn more about the events at here[/url]

Thank you ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: [End]New & Ongoing Event (June 22 - July 5, Pacific Daylight Time)
notes.content:
New & ongoing events for you. Check out this post to learn more 

[h1]Events (Pacific Daylight Time)[/h1]
1. Summer Sales up to 60% (June 22 - July 5)
2. Hot Time Event (June 22 - July 5)
3. Gifts for New and Returning Players (June 22 - July 5)
4. Golden Time Event (June 22 - July 5, Fridays and weekends)
5. Limited Monthly Perfect Attendance Award (June and July)

[h1]Learn More[/h1]
[b]1. Summer Sales up to 60%[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/1f7145fed7690d2e6d09293bb72c9a96681842f0.png[/img]
Chance to get more than 280 items at a 50% to 60% discounted price!
You can check the items at the Store's [u]Sale[/u] tab in the game!

[b]2. Hot Time Event[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/8218bd6ffc3553aa82046b95d36ef0679765b63d.png[/img]
Stay online for 15 mins and get Hot Time Boxes during the event period!
[list][*]Hot Times
[list][*]05:00 - 06:00 AM (PDT)
[*]10:00 - 11:00 AM (PDT)
[*]18:00 - 19:00 PM (PDT)[/list]
[*]The Hot Time Box will be sent to the mailbox automatically.
[*]Get one of [u]50,000 Beats, Exp Bonus, White Dragon - Teen (1 day), Name Change, and 100% off Coupon (Hair)[/u] from the box at random!
[*]You can get maximum 3 Hot Time Boxes per day if you attend all three hot times[/list]

[b]3. Gifts for New and Returning Players[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/bdd8c1a11836cee91b7a15d7ae625d35a3d04ece.png[/img]
The gifts for new and returning players changed!
Don't miss the attendance and get every gifts~!
[list][*][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/0defb0e8bb58df7d2c6ebc47a269d4034ab9339a.png]Check the gifts for New players[/url]
[*][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/de71935ede28845fec3870f3763f06799c71235e.png]Check the gifts for Returning players[/url][/list]

[b]4. Golden Time Event[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/7037b54dd16050a001a1ece011cd89d33ba9c57e.png[/img]
Play Fam Battle mode and get extra beats, exp, and stars!
[list][*][u]Golden Times[/u]
[list][*]Every Fridays and Weekends
[*]05:00 - 06:00 AM (PDT)
[*]10:00 - 11:00 AM (PDT)
[*]18:00 - 19:00 PM (PDT)[/list]
[*][u]Rewards[/u]
[list][*]Fridays: Beats +300, Exp +200, and Stars +5 per play
[*]Weekends: Beats +600, Exp +400, and Stars +10 per play[/list][/list]

[b]5. Limited Monthly Perfect Attendance Award (June and July)[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/cb609abb65855ac634bb11dd16efab0ee8bbecba.png[/img]
The monthly perfect attendance award for June and July updated.
Check the attendance every day on June for 80% off coupon (Set item)! 
You may get an 80% off coupon (Hair item) in July as well.

[h1]Previous Notice[/h1]
[list][*][url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/354290/announcements/detail/2790391902839772127]Check the Patch Note on June 22, 2017[/url]
[*][url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/354290/announcements/detail/1262544621829864660]Click here to learn more about previous events[/url][/list]

Thank you!

notes.title: [Complete] Maintenance & Patch Note on June 22, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/59fdbe0498fc86272549fbacbb57abd680e7915b.png[/img]
Hello, Dancers.
We will be performing scheduled maintenance to update and provide a good service.
During this time the game will be unavailable for play.

[h1]Date and time[/h1]
[strike]June 21, 2017 @ 10:00 PM - June 22, 1:00 AM (Pacific Daylight Time, UTC-7)
June 22, 2017 @ 6:00 AM - 9:00 AM (Central European Time, UTC+1)
June 22, 2017 @ 2:00 PM - 5:00 PM (Korea Time, UTC+9)
※ The time of maintenance might be changed depending on works.[/strike]
[b]※ The maintenance completed at 0:48 AM (PDT). Thank you for the cooperation:)[/b]

[h1]Patch Note[/h1]
An update to LoveBeat will be released. The major changes include:
[list][*]New Items
[list][*]50 parts items, 6 accessories, 8 set items, and 2 balloons[/list]

[*]Fam Renewals
[list]
[*]Fam Grade extended from 10 to 15.
[*]Fam Story added. Clearing the Fam mission, you may available to get the game bonus and exclusive Fam items.[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/cf9a5404321a36c7d9536ab9df5ff4b8ee2eedef.png]Check for them![/url]
[*]Fam points you can get from playing and checking attendance has changed.
[*]Black Dragon from 'Dragon Series' added in Special Shop's Fam tab. Black Dragon gives extra Fam point, and your Fam needs to be at least 10 Grade.[/list]

[*]New Songs
[list][*]Money (RAP, HIPHOP, LATIN) by JOVI EL NEYCOM
[*]Nothings over by Night Time Blue
[*]Fernweh (feat. Mindmovie) by KEVIN S.
[*]Tune Crashers & SG - Party like a psycho by SG
[*]L'Egotrip by Woochia[/list]

[*]Fixes and other changes
[list][*]Notice banners changed
[*]30 Songs have removed due to the patch volume
[*]HOT songs list changed[/list][/list]

[h1]Previous Event[/h1]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/354290/announcements/detail/2790391902839880633]New & Ongoing Event (June 22 - July 5, Pacific Daylight Time)[/url]

Thank you!

notes.content:
New & ongoing events for you. Check out this post to learn more:JoyfulLalabit:

[h1]Events (Pacific Daylight Time)[/h1]
1. Time Gauge Event (June 8 - June 21)
2. Long Live the Fam Event (June 8 - June 21)
3. Monthly Perfect Attendance Award on June

[h1]Learn More[/h1]
[b]1. Time Gauge Event[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/c3def7a1c53647df21b1b1ecc4af119c2d70dd6e.png[/img]
Time Gauge Event Came Back, Collect Time Gauge and Get Rewards!

[u]What are the rewards?[/u]
[list][*]Couple Card, Name Change, Discount coupons(up to 80%), and... [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/545cd49ae839472d6e195eeaacf6d78ca8bba1d9.png]Check for the details![/url]
[*]You can get 1 reward among the list per each step.
[*]You can only get 1 reward per a day. The reward reset time is 12:00 am (Pacific Daylight Time)[/list]

[b]2. Long Live the Fam Event[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/829e0f333c9101762f6483c4cb57b7d6679db1f6.png[/img]
Introduce your Fam to other LoveBeat players!
The posting will be shared on our official FaeBook page.
In addition, the gifts will be given to every participant, wishing for the prosperity of your Fam!

[u]How to Join the Event[/u]

(1) Introduce your Fam on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/354290/images/]Artwork[/url]. 

(2) The posting should include the [b]Screenshot of your Fam page[/b], the [b]name of the Fam[/b], game [b]nickname of Fam master[/b], and the [b]short description of your Fam[/b] [u]in English.[/u]
If you have [b]Fam website[/b], don't forget to add them as well.

(3) For the participants, the New Fam Skin [b]"Blue Mojito (7 days)"[/b] and the [b]"Fam Mark Change"[/b] Items will be given to their Fam masters.
※ The Fam grade should be at least 3 at the end of the event period to get rewards.

(4) Leave your posting link as the comment on this Event post.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/fe9191ff26231bab0deeb90d3b8c73e6b2e97654.png[/img]

[u]Gift for Fam members[/u]
[list][*]The gift for participated Fam members is also prepared!
[*]For every Fam members who participated on [u]"Long Live the Fam Event"[/u] will get 150,000 beats!

※ The Fam grade should be at least 3 at the end of the event period to get a reward.
※ You should be the member of the Fam at the point event ends(6/21 before maintenance, PDT) to get a reward.[/list]

[b]3. Monthly Perfect Attendance Award on June[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/cb609abb65855ac634bb11dd16efab0ee8bbecba.png[/img]
The monthly perfect attendance award for June updated.
Check the attendance every day and grab 80% off coupon(Set items)!
The Gifts by attendance Stamps has changed, so you don't want to miss them!
[list][*][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/2880288a87927a822020c88001b0ce90604c81b8.png]Check for the Changed items![/url][/list]

[h1]Previous Events[/h1]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/354290/announcements/detail/1262543429199855499]Click here to learn more about previous events[/url]

Thank you!

notes.content:
New & ongoing events for you. Check out this post to learn more :JoyfulLalabit:

[b]2. Defeat the Monsters Medley[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/11b05d78224d5f894b8bbe166029468fbdbf20ee.png[/img]
With an update of 'Bomber Lambert', more events are waiting for you! 

[list][b]1) Get Exclusive Boss items![/b]
[list][*]Chance to get exclusive boss items has doubled in every stage during the event period! [/list]
[b]2) Daily Golden Time for Monster mode[/b]
[list][*]The Monster mode has added in Daily Golden time for the event period!
[*]Daily Golden Time (Pacific Daylight Time)
Every 5 am - 6 am, 10 am - 11 am and 6 pm - 7 pm
You can get Star points by playing 'Defeat the Monster', 'Team Survival', 'Friend Zone', 'Team Dance Fighter', and 'Meeting Party'[/list]
[b]3) Let's Defeat the Monsters Part II[/b]

[list][*][b]Winners[/b]

[/list][/list]

[b]3. Wear like a Prom[/b]

Dress up like a prom party and get the costumes you wore!
[list][*][b]How to Join the Event[/b]
1) Upload the screenshot on your SNS or our Steam community hub. You should write the items you used for the event so that we can send rewards!

2) Submit the post link to this announcement page as a comment with your in-game name and Steam account info.
[u]Example of the submission[/u]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/b565748f2c203039718b5333508cdbc2bfa4f7ac.png[/img]

[*]Second Session (April 27 - May 3)

[list][*]80 parts items, 37 accessories, 8 set items, and 2 balloons[/list]

[*]Special Shop renewals
[list][*]Personal, Couple, and Fam items have added in the Special Shop.
Certain status or level may be required for Special items.
[*]Personal pose 'Comic Dance' added. Player level 70+ can purchase the item.
[*]Couple pose 'Holding Hands' added in the Couple tab. 
[*]New mounts 'Dragon Series' added in Special Shop's Fam tab. Dragons give extra Fam points. You need to be a member of Fam to purchase Dragon mounts.
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/3f33224d1ee222f039166d27d312634c7cb027f9.png]Check for the image![/url][/list]

notes.title: [Complete]Maintenance & Patch Note on March 9, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/10159a286ea127e7cdc7394e74349d2359a0fd03.png[/img]
Hello, Dancers.
We will be performing scheduled maintenance to update and provide good service.
During this time the game will be unavailable for play.

[h1]Date and time[/h1]
[strike]March 8, 2017 @ 9:00 PM - Midnight (Pacific Time, UTC-8)
March 9, 2017 @ 6:00 AM - 9:00 AM (Central European Time, UTC+1)
March 9, 2017 @ 2:00 PM - 5:00 PM (Korea Time, UTC+9)[/strike]
[b]Completed at 11:53 PM (Pacific Time)[/b]
※ The time of maintenance might be changed depending on works.

[h1]Patch Note[/h1]
An update to LoveBeat will be released. The major changes include:
[list][*]New Mode 'Title Collector' Updated
[list][*]Play title mode and collect titles! More than 200 titles are waiting for the collectors!
[*]Check the screenshot how the titles would look like!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/85ffb8e410d44ab25dca72bd0ab8c1da150a62b4.jpg[/img][/list]
[*]The titles you gained will be initialized in every 2 weeks (after the biweekly maintenance)
[/list]

[*]New Items
[list][*]Remove Latest Title: Delete the latest title you gained in the title mode.
[*]Title Preservation: Preserve the title you gained.
[*]Title Initialization: Initialize all title you own now.
[*]New Slot Skins, Personal, Couple, and Fam Skin added along with backgrounds
[*]74 parts, 22 accessories, 3 sets, and 2 balloons
[/list]

[*]New Songs
[list][*]Wish You Were Here (Radio edit) by Brain Purist
[*]Love We Found by JAEK
[*]Aku & Duniaku by Samista
[*]Rainbow Stone by FRESH BODY SHOP
[*]Chau amor - Naxuel Tevez by NAXUEL@HOTMAIL.COM
[/list]

[*]Fixes and Other changes
[list][*]Notice banners changed
[*]Intro and Ending image changed
[*]Game interfaces including store and waiting room changed to Spring Theme
[*]The icon align in store and inventory fixed
[*]8 keys and random option has blocked in the Monster mode
[/list][/list]

[h1]Upcoming Changes on March 23[/h1]
[list][*]Personal, Couple, and Fam items will be added in the Special Shop.
Certain status or level may be required for Special items.
[*][u]Personal Pose[/u] 'Squirrel Pose', 'Poochy Temptation', and 'Round and Happiness' will be moved to [b]Special Shop[/b] from Function tab
[*][u]Couple Pose[/u] 'Harana', 'Cutey Kitty', 'Couple Dance', 'Photographer', 'Hit the Wall', and 'Close Together' will be moved to [b]Special Shop[/b] from Couple tab
[*]Requiring Couple level will change
[list][*]Couple pose 'Photographer': Couple Level 5
[*]Couple pose 'Hit the Wall': Couple Level 5
[*]Couple pose 'Close Together': Couple Level 10
[/list][/list]

[h1]Remark[/h1]
The Daylight Saving Time 2017 Starts from March 12. The in-game time will be changed to the Pacific Daylight Time from then.

[h1]Previous News[/h1]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/354290/announcements/detail/514938661823756093]New & Ongoing Event (March 9 - March 22, Pacific time)[/url]

Thank you ːJoyfulLalabitː

notes.title: [End][Event] New & Ongoing Event (February 23 - March 8, Pacific time)
notes.content:
How's the start of a Spring!
Here are the New & ongoing events for you. Check out this post to learn more :JoyfulLalabit:

[h1]Events (Pacific Time)[/h1]
1. Costume Package Sales (Feb 23 - Mar 8)
2. Stamp Event (Feb 23 - Mar 8)
3. Waiting for Spring Event (Feb 23 - Mar 8)
4. Be the Fashion Stylist! (Mar 1 - Mar 31)
5. Monthly Perfect Attendance Award on March

[h1]Learn More[/h1]
[b]1. Costume Package Sales[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/5088900ede6b66bddcd2cef824db88a9f9804f7f.png[/img]
A chance to get new costumes at a 20% discounted price for a limited time!
[list][*]Permanent costume packages for trendy people!
[*]Special Emotion Random Box comes together with the package.
*You can get a Special Emotion among [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/dc5910affcd1f7b6c351e051005688ebc3591f58.png]5 fancy poses.[/url]
*Notice: You can also buy the items singly at an original price.
[/list]

[b]2. Stamp Event[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/ff4f3a9be08022ec1a83a7be1a809f31bd890df2.png[/img]
Collect Stamps for a Heart ride!
[list][*]You need to play together with 2+ players in individual mode and 4+ players in team mode.
[*]Exchange stamps to: Double Power, Accessory Mystery Box, and Heart Floater!
[/list]

[b]3. Waiting for Spring Event[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/bcfe80c71625d304721ee3a31eb8cc7900a45f14.png[/img]
Share your Spring outfits and get costumes!
[list][*]How to join the Event (Theme: Spring Outfits)
1) Upload the screenshot on your Facebook or our Steam community hub.
2) Submit the post link to this announcement page as a comment with your in-game name and Steam account info.

[u]Example of the submission[/u]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/b565748f2c203039718b5333508cdbc2bfa4f7ac.png[/img]

3) Receive rewards! The winner will be decided by GMs' opinion and 'likes' on the post!
One female and male outfit will be selected respectively.

[*]What are the gifts?
[list][*]Part items (7 days) you used to coordinate for Spring outfits!
[/list]


[b]Winner[/b]
- Miwaki- [url=https://m.facebook.com/story.php?story_fbid=1425917897453604&id=100001062215865]Click here to see Miwaki-'s Spring costume![/url]

*Notice: Part item includes [b]Hair, Tops, Bottoms, and Shoes[/b] only. Accessories used will not be given. The rewards will be sent after the event period.
[/list]

[b]4. Be the Fashion Stylist![/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/90eb909561765ed181611f75f1b600b612e6aa90.png[/img]
Make your own style in LoveBeat!

Post your style as a monthly theme. GMs will select some styles and the selected items will be updated in the near future named after your in-game name. When your items updated, we will give the 1-day items to you for free!
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=868885691]Click here to check it out for rules and example[/url]


[b]5. Monthly Perfect Attendance Award on March[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/0c61546a1b91cc96c921c4ae9a6a586f16b1b5ff.png[/img]
The monthly perfect attendance award for March updated.

Check the attendance every day and grab permanent exclusive accessory item!
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/14da0401af50544920d59bb9aae280e5ab533e58.png]Click here to check the item image![/url]

[h1]Previous Events[/h1]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/354290/announcements/detail/514936758237088058]Click here to learn more about previous events[/url]


Thank you :KissingLalabit:

notes.title: [Complete]Maintenance & Patch Note on February 23, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11028929/1d09061305faeb1bc7a4a6715b5d0c557449a088.png[/img]
Hello, Dancers.
We will be performing scheduled maintenance to update and provide good service.
During this time the game will be unavailable for play.

[h1]Date and time[/h1]
[strike]February 22, 2017 @ 9:00 PM - Midnight (Pacific Standard Time, UTC-8)
February 23, 2017 @ 6:00 AM - 9:00 AM (Central European Time, UTC+1)

An update to LoveBeat will be released. The major changes include:
[list][*]New function 'No-Go room'
[list][*]If you don't play the game more than 10 minutes, the room status will be changed to 'No-Go' room automatically.
[*]You can always switch the status to a Normal room by starting a game.[/list]
[*]New Item
[list][*]Whole New Community
- Item to initialize your community list. Your name will be removed from the community who added you as well.
[*]Angel Wings Effect and Tag added
[*]66 parts, 13 accessories, 7 sets, and 2 balloons
[/list]
[*]New Songs
[list][*]This Is How We Stand by Mirva (Difficulty added)
[*]Curse the Day (Radio Edit) by Brain Purist
[*]I don't care remix ft Sandro Martelly by Steves J. Bryan
[*]New Trend by ANNY SKY
[*]Anything But Everything by COLOR OUT
[/list]
[*]Fixes and Other changes
[list][*]Notice banners changed
[*]Intro, Loading, and Ending image has changed
[*]Arrow keys bug fixed
[/list][/list]

[h1]Previous News[/h1]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/354290/announcements/detail/514936412772958678]LoveBeat Clean Campaign crackdown period[/url]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/354290/announcements/detail/514937393226679254]New & Ongoing Event (February 23 - March 8, Pacific time)[/url]

Thank you :JoyfulLalabit:
